C0399.title: Professional Account Farming: The Hidden Force Behind Telecom Fraud
C0399.summary: Since 2019, a gang led by Lu set up workshops in Longyan, Fujian, and other locations, purchasing large numbers of mobile phones and overseas SIM cards. They simulated real user behavior—such as posting to Moments, liking posts, and using step counters—to batch-farm WeChat accounts, disguising them as finance professionals before selling them at high prices to fraud rings.
